blocks.html: The data to update product categories.

types.name: UpdateProductCategoriesWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to update product categories.

children.name: selector
children.description: The filters to select the product categories to update.

children.name: $and
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.

children.name: $or
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "or" condition.

children.name: q
children.description: Filter product categories based on searchable fields

children.name: id
children.description: The IDs to filter product categories by.

children.name: name
children.description: The names to filter product categories by.

children.name: parent_category_id
children.description: Filter product categories by their parent category's ID.

children.name: handle
children.description: The handles to filter product categories by.

children.name: is_active
children.description: Filter product categories by whether they're active.

children.name: is_internal
children.description: Filter product categories by whether they're internal.

children.name: external_id
children.description: Filter product categories by external ID.

children.name: include_descendants_tree
children.description: Whether to include children of retrieved product categories.

children.name: include_ancestors_tree
children.description: Whether to include parents of retrieved product categories.

children.name: update
children.description: The data to update in the product categories.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the product category.

children.name: description
children.description: The product category's description.

children.name: handle
children.description: The handle of the product category.

children.name: is_active
children.description: Whether the product category is active.

children.name: is_internal
children.description: Whether the product category is internal. This can be used to only show the product category to admins and hide it from customers.

children.name: rank
children.description: The ranking of the category among sibling categories.

children.name: parent_category_id
children.description: The ID of the parent product category, if it has any.

children.name: external_id
children.description: An external identifier for the product category, such as an ID from a third-party system.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
